options.metric: Annual count of pedestrians killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes
options.denominator: None; total number of pedestrians killed per calendar year
options.reason: A bar chart makes the discrete annual totals easy to compare directly.
options.interpretation: This framing answers how many pedestrians were killed in each calendar year, with one bar for each annual total. Annual counts are a direct match for the question and make year-to-year differences easy to compare. It does not explain the causes of crashes or provide population-adjusted risk.

options.reason: A line chart emphasizes the direction and continuity of the annual count over time.
options.interpretation: This framing answers the annual-count question while making the trajectory from 2013 through 2025 especially apparent.
